about: Reworded steering lines, written on their own and not tuned to the lint: the lint catches some and not others, and the checker must flag every one of them (AI.6 review, proposal 6 rows 14-15). Plain ASCII, no digits, one line each; each is added as a bullet to short, long and Skill notes. The first seven are the examples from the review that found the first version calling 22 of 24 such lines clean.
